# ~ WuBuGov ~

**Government-grade infrastructure for the ~ WuBu ~ space.**

**~ WuBu ~ is my space. This is WaefreBeorn.**

WuBuGov is the public-facing digital governance arm of WaefreBeorn: a
conversation and conversion from land-owning corporations to the
dissolution of corporate entities, toward **space capitalism** — value
flowing from creation, not extraction.
